column1: # Roles of the harness, one `role<TAB>access<TAB>output<TAB>description` line each. access: ro (never edits files)
# or rw. output: findings (first line "Findings: N BLOCKER, M SHOULD-FIX, K NIT", recorded as N,M,K) or done.
# Each role's instructions: .agents/harness/roles/<role>.md, copied into every generated agent file.

column4: Plans a change: resolves open questions, file-by-file plan, test matrix, weakest decisions. Never edits.
Attacks a plan from another model family than the Proposer's. Never edits.
Writes the acceptance tests first, then the code, in small commits with narrow checks green.
Adversarial review of the diff from another model family than the Implementer's. Never edits.
Reviews the diff as an attacker (secrets, injection, permissions, harness bypass). Never edits.
Answers closed read-only questions fast: where is X, what calls Y, what does this log say.
Applies mechanical edits with no judgment: renames, formatting, version bumps.
